messages.author: e1aa1f1044f2548f
messages.subject: Strange error from shiny server
parts:
Hi,

Has anyone seen the following error message in the web browser after loading a shiny app:

ERROR: IncompatibleClassChangeError (Java): Class org.apache.poi.hssf.usermodel.HSSFDataFormat does not implement the requested interface org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.DataFormat

That is the only message that comes up in the browser. The app runs locally without glitch, and our shiny server installation runs other apps without any problem. Also, I copied a different app into the same folder and it works, so it is definitively related to this one project. It's quite a complex project, and before I start taking out bits and pieces to figure out what might have caused the error, I though that if anyone has an idea, it may really save me a lot of time,,,,

Thanks, Philipp

messages.author: e1aa1f1044f2548f
messages.subject: Strange error from shiny server
parts:
Found it.

For future reference: I had called the library XLConnect. Bad idea. It is Windows-only and doesn't play nicely with shiny.
